prompt:
Same woman as Виктория.png; same face, one woman. Eyes green with a slight hazel-brown tint (зелёные с лёгким карим). Warm honey blonde with darker roots, not platinum. Soft tender expression.
One static PNG 3:4@4K, 3×3 grid. Thin white gutters exactly at 1/3 and 2/3 (Excalibur seam). #111111 + white heavy sans + #ff006e. Type ≥12% from seams. In-scene. No video.
01 Victoria in graphite silk pajama shirt + black trousers, 3/4 on rumpled dark bed, look over shoulder. Cat senses distance. "You spend your nights together" "and talk until sunrise. Yet when you ask where this is going, he smiles: "Why ruin it with labels?"" "Why Put Labels On It"
02 dog at a closed door. "Wifey loyalty on zero terms" "You give devotion and emotional care, yet feel terrified to ask "what are we?" without seeming needy."
03 torn magenta tape. "The cool girl trap" "You hold back your needs. You hope that if you ask for nothing, he will appreciate your patience and commit."
04 owl sees the contract. "The 100/0 Situationship contract" "He gets 100% of relationship perks with 0% accountability. "No labels" is simply an easy exit clause."
05 two columns. "Committed vs The Grey Zone" "Committed: clear status, shared future, emotional safety" "Grey Zone: terms on his schedule, plans for tonight, anxiety"
06 three cards. "Says vs Hears vs Reality" "Says: "Why ruin a great vibe with heavy labels?"" "You hear: "He values pure, organic connection"" "Reality: "I want full access without being accountable""
07 checklist. "3 clarity tests to know where you stand" "1. Public test: does his inner circle know you are a couple?" "2. Support test: is he present on a messy Tuesday afternoon?" "3. Direct test: does asking about status trigger defensive anger?"
08 "Clarity is the bare minimum" "A man who avoids calling you his is keeping the exit door unlocked. Your heart is not an audition room."
09 Victoria in petrol-teal silk blouse + espresso suede jacket, standing 3/4. "Comment LABELS" "Audio reading in my app. Essence–Shadow–Vector." "Write LABELS in the comments" "Clarity now"
Verbatim only. No extra labels.
